items.exampleEn: Mosquitoes are bothersome on hot summer nights.
items.exampleZh: 炎熱的夏夜裡，蚊子很惱人。

items.exampleEn: The two old friends sat wordlessly by the lake.
items.exampleZh: 那兩位老朋友不發一語地坐在湖邊。

items.exampleEn: The movie has a heartwarming ending.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影有一個溫馨感人的結局。

items.exampleEn: His unselfish pass helped his teammate score the winning goal.
items.exampleZh: 他無私的傳球幫助隊友踢進致勝一球。

items.exampleEn: Worries about the new job preoccupied him for weeks.
items.exampleZh: 對新工作的擔心佔據了他好幾個星期的心思。

items.exampleEn: The fireworks left the whole crowd spellbound.
items.exampleZh: 煙火讓全場觀眾看得入迷。

items.exampleEn: She looked jealously at her sister's new bike.
items.exampleZh: 她嫉妒地看著姊姊的新腳踏車。

items.exampleEn: It was a daft idea to go swimming in the middle of winter.
items.exampleZh: 大冬天去游泳真是個傻主意。

items.sentenceEn: Don't be daft; of course you can come with us.
items.sentenceZh: 別傻了，你當然可以跟我們一起來。

items.audioEn: The bothersome noise from upstairs stopped at midnight, so we finally slept.
items.audioZh: 樓上惱人的噪音到半夜才停，我們終於睡著了。
items.questionZh: 樓上的噪音什麼時候停？

items.sentenceEn: The cat jealously watched the new puppy eat from its bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻貓嫉妒地看著新來的小狗用牠的碗吃東西。

items.sentenceEn: I was so preoccupied with the game that I forgot to eat lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 我太專心玩遊戲，忘了吃午餐。

items.stemEn: The ____ story about a lost dog finding its way home made everyone smile.
items.stemZh: 走失的狗自己找到路回家，這個溫馨的故事讓大家都笑了。

items.stemEn: Planning her garden ____ my mother all spring; she could talk about nothing else.
items.stemZh: 規劃花園佔據了我媽媽整個春天的心思，她什麼別的都不談。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, our family held a surprise party for my grandmother's eightieth birthday. My little brother and my grandmother are inseparable, and although he is usually busy with his phone, he spent a week making her a card. At the party, he wordlessly handed it to her, and she hugged him for a long time. It was a heartwarming moment. Later, she told the children stories about her childhood, and they sat spellbound. My cousin gave up his holiday trip to help plan the party, a truly unselfish choice.
items.passageZh: 上週日，我們家為祖母八十歲生日辦了一場驚喜派對。我弟弟和祖母形影不離，雖然他平常總是忙著滑手機，但他花了一個星期替她做卡片。派對上，他一句話也沒說就把卡片遞給她，她抱了他好久。那是很溫馨的一刻。後來，她跟孩子們講她小時候的故事，孩子們都聽得入迷。我表哥放棄了自己的假期旅行來幫忙籌備派對，真是很無私的選擇。

questions.questionZh: 弟弟花了一星期做什麼？
表哥做了什麼無私的事？
options: 替大家買了一頓豐盛的晚餐
放棄假期幫忙籌備派對

items.promptZh: 排長長的隊買票真的很煩人。
referenceEn: Waiting in a long line for tickets is really bothersome.
It is really bothersome to wait in a long line for tickets.
rubricZh: 要用 bothersome（例如 is really bothersome）
「排隊」可寫，例如 wait in line、stand in line 等

items.instructionZh: 用 heartwarming 造一個句子，說說一個讓你覺得溫馨感人的故事或時刻。
referenceEn: My grandparents' fiftieth wedding anniversary was a heartwarming day.
The moment my dog ran to meet me at the airport was heartwarming.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 heartwarming（例如 a heartwarming day、was heartwarming 等）
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：違反第一義＝例句詞義（§11.27）：單字卡例句 "jealously guarded his special cooking method" 是「小心守護地」義（exampleZh 也譯「小心翼翼地守住」），但 glossZh 第一義是「嫉妒地」；App 單字卡只顯示第一義，會對不上。建議改為「小心守護地；嫉妒地」，或把例句改成嫉妒義。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/6 的修正紀錄。
